SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. E-REC.
S. R. D. 7710
Date December 11, 36.
〔此处转录不清：右上角印章及手写编号区域〕
Subject: Comment on article of the NOVY PUT re: a meeting of the confraternity
of the Seventh Day Adventists.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.I.

In an article by Mr. Andrei Buteneff published in the
"Novy Put" on December 8, 1936, reference is made to the keen
disappointment experienced by the author when, instead of a
promising lecture entitled "Pyramids and the Bible," which had
been extensively advertised by posters etc. in French Town,
the public were treated to a religious ceremony on the part of
the confraternity of The Seventh Day Adventists led by a Russian
lawyer named N/Shikis. The meeting is described in the article
in question in an exceedingly scathing manner which might be
considered offensive by members of this particular religious
sect.

The meeting referred to above took place on December 6
in The Seventh Day Adventists' church in Avenue Joffre.

The offices of the NOVY PUT, a Russian daily published
and edited by Mr. P. A. Ballod, are situated at 706 Avenue
Joffre.

〔左侧页边批注：20R 12/12〕

Referring my representations G. Prokofiev
D.S.I.

D.C. (Special Branch).
〔印章：SPECIAL BRANCH 14 DEC 1936〕

S.B. 11/12 S.2.
D&R 14/12

〔此处转录不清：右上角印章及手写编号区域〕
主题：关于《新路》（Novy Put）刊登的一篇有关基督复临安息日会教友团集会的文章的评论。
由副督察普罗科菲耶夫（D.S.I. Prokofiev）撰写，由副督察 J. Boyne 转呈。

在安德烈·布捷涅夫（Andrei Buteneff）先生于1936年12月8日在《新路》报上发表的一篇文章中，提到了作者所经历的强烈失望之情。此前，法租界内曾通过海报等方式广泛宣传一场题为“金字塔与圣经”的讲座，备受期待，但公众最终看到的却是名为 N/Shikis 的俄罗斯律师领导的基督复临安息日会教友团举行的宗教仪式。该文章以极其尖刻的口吻描述了这次集会，这种描述可能会被该特定宗教派别的成员视为具有冒犯性。

上述集会于12月6日在霞飞路的基督复临安息日会教堂举行。

《新路》报是一家俄文日报，由 P. A. Ballod 先生出版并编辑，其办事处位于霞飞路706号。

〔左侧页边批注：20R 12/12〕

就我的陈述而言 G. Prokofiev
副督察

助理处长（特科）。
〔印章：特科 1936年12月14日〕

Summarised translation from the Russian daily
newspaper NOVY PUT, December 8, 1936. Published
and edited by Mr. P. A. Ballod. Editorial and
printing offices - 706 Avenue Joffre.

'About 150 persons gathered in the Adventists church,
Avenue Joffre, the day before yesterday. Apparently, the
majority of the audience were attracted by curiosity and by
extensive advertising. During ten days preceding the
meeting posters announcing a lecture entitled "Pyramids and
the Bible" could be seen everywhere in the streets of the
French Concession populated by Russians.

Although not a word had been said about it in the
posters, the lecture was preceded by a religious service of th
sect of Adventists. The service was conducted by .....
Mr. Shikis! This caused an enormous surprise. It would
seem that there can be nothing in common between Mr. Shikis
and the ignorant fanatics who think that they are living
saints. An incredible paradox: Mr. Shikis, a well-educated
person, in the role of a leader of religious castrati!
Well fed, "peasantly plump" and possessing a very "unspiritual'
face Mr. Shikis did not look like a living saint.

Upon Shikis' invitation the sectarians sang several
hymns of a sanctimonious character. A "sister" was asked
to collect voluntary donations. The service lasted full
three quarters of an hour. Then, at last, the lecturer made
his appearance.

The author comments briefly on the lecture which, in
his opinion, was a very poor one in every respect,
and concludes the article with the following remarks:-

Of all foreign religious sects which, for reasons
unknown, are called rationalistic sects, this particular
sect is the most ignorant and obscure. If it can be said
that the methodists and baptists, compared with the Western
and Eastern Orthodox churches, have very little of RATIO
(reason), the adventists have none at all. Their dogma tends
towards Judaism of Talmud and, what is most important, is
calculated to undermine the normal state of human mind by the

摘自1936年12月8日俄文日报《新路》的翻译摘要。由 P. A. Ballod 先生出版并编辑。编辑部及印刷所——霞飞路706号。

“前天，约有150人聚集在霞飞路的复临派教堂。显然，大多数听众是出于好奇以及受到大量广告宣传的吸引而来。在集会前的十天里，在俄国人聚居的法租界街道上，随处可见宣布举行题为‘金字塔与圣经’讲座的海报。

尽管海报上只字未提，但在讲座之前先举行了复临派的宗教仪式。仪式由 ____ Shikis 先生主持！这引起了巨大的惊讶。似乎受过良好教育的 Shikis 先生与那些自认为是活圣徒的无知狂热分子之间没有任何共同之处。这是一个令人难以置信的悖论：Shikis 先生，一个受过良好教育的人，竟然扮演宗教阉割派领袖的角色！Shikis 先生营养充足，有着‘农民般的丰满’体态，长着一张非常‘非精神化’的脸，看起来不像是一位活圣徒。

应 Shikis 的邀请，教徒们唱了几首带有伪善性质的赞美诗。一位‘姐妹’被要求募集自愿捐款。仪式持续了整整四分之三小时。然后，演讲者终于露面。

作者简要评论了这场讲座，他认为这场讲座在各方面都非常糟糕，并以以下 remarks 结束文章：-

在所有因未知原因被称为理性主义派别的外国宗教派别中，这一特定派别是最无知和最晦涩的。如果说与西方和东方正教会相比，卫理公会和浸信会所具有的 RATIO（理性）很少，那么复临派则完全没有理性。他们的教义倾向于塔木德犹太教，而且最重要的是，旨在通过

However, this sect would not attract much attention,
if, apart from the features of a religious nature, it
did not possess features of a political interest. The

disintegrating and anti-nationalist character. This
should attract the attention of certain quarters, as the

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. S. B. D. 7710
Date December 31, 1936 / 37

Subject Article of the "NOVY PUT" res a meeting of the confraternity of
the Seventh Day Adventists.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by [Signature]

（左侧边栏批注：
* See also
D 1709
[Signature]
8/12
）

With reference to the endorsement of D.C. (Special
Branch) on the attached report dated 11-12-36, I have to state
that no further articles have so far appeared in the local Rus-
sian press on the subject of the confraternity of the Seventh
Day Adventists.

It appears that neither Mr. Shikis nor the religious
confraternity concerned have taken any steps in connection with
this matter.

A. Prokofiev
D.S.I.

D.C. ( Special Branch )
（印：31 DEC. 1936 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

关于助理处长（特科）在附带的1936年12月11日报告上的批示，我必须声明，截至目前，当地俄文报刊上没有再出现关于基督复临安息日会教友团主题的文章。

看来，Shikis 先生或相关的宗教教友团均未就此事项采取任何行动。

A. Prokofiev
副督察
